description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2): uniform flow at Fr 0.77 (slope 5e-3, n 0.03, q 3 m2/s) in a channel ten cells wide between banks of dry cells (geo.dat): the same velocity in all ten cells. With the Froude limit 0.1 A 531 in every cell next to a dry cell the two bank cells ran at 0.41 of the velocity and the channel 8-14 % too deep.
covers: sflow_momentum_func::velcalc, Froude limit next to dry cells only below A 232
